scope: Indexed static evidence for HHA scan/overlap suppression, HHAGradeMailFlag xrefs, and SystemMailSend record queueing. It stops before live mailbox delivery.

scan.order: x increases first within each row; at row end x resets to row start and z increments

candidate_rules.lookup: For each unvisited anchor, 0x7b1fe0 calls 0xb13fe0; a valid returned object descriptor proceeds to footprint handling.
candidate_rules.score_gate: Only the iVar24 == 0 path and successful 0xba7f80 predicate add width * depth to +0x150.
candidate_rules.footprint_mark: After that conditional score block, the returned object's full footprint is traversed and its scan bitmap cells are marked regardless of whether the score predicate passed.
candidate_rules.empty_or_failed_lookup: Empty (-2) and failed auxiliary lookup paths mark only the anchor bit; they do not add area.

deterministic_overlap_consequence.contained_later_anchor: If an earlier scanned valid object marks a later object's anchor cell, the later anchor is skipped before resolver lookup. This can suppress its score contribution even when the earlier object's own score predicate failed.
deterministic_overlap_consequence.overlap_without_contained_anchor: If both anchors remain unvisited, both eligible objects can contribute their full width * depth; the accumulator does not subtract intersection area.
deterministic_overlap_consequence.same_anchor: The resolver returns one cell descriptor. The indexed getter does not enumerate all objects occupying that coordinate, so it cannot identify which same-cell furniture record won.
deterministic_overlap_consequence.ordering: For distinct anchors, the first scanned anchor's footprint can determine whether a later anchor is visited; this is a deterministic x-fast row-major scan rule, not evidence of which object occupies a single grid cell.

resolver_and_grid_limit.cell_getter: 0x52d640 reads a single short cell value; sentinel -3 decodes a coordinate and makes one fallback lookup in the alternate grid.
resolver_and_grid_limit.generic_writer: 0x52df00 unconditionally writes a single cell value; rectangle updater 0x52e360 calls it. Indexed direct callers of 0x52df00 are 0x52d980 and 0x52e360.
resolver_and_grid_limit.unresolved: The static corpus does not tie the furniture-grid population/update sequence to object creation order at a shared anchor. Exact same-cell winner remains unproven without a matching grid writer path or runtime grid capture.

grade_mail_flag.conclusion: All indexed exact-name native references point to the setter path 0x7b1fe0. No indexed EventFlow read/write, exact-name native reader/clearer, pseudocode reading, or CRC32-key reference was found. This does not exclude a consumer that uses an unresolved encoding or requires runtime observation.

route_enum.label: cSlowRetry
route_enum.note: The direct handler is attempted before the mode-3 fallback.

fast_today_mode_1.native_method: 0xac7070 via record virtual slot +0x30; both indexed record pointer-array candidates resolve to this method
fast_today_mode_1.slot_picker: 0xfad540 chooses the first available record among four slots
fast_today_mode_1.record_writer: 0xfaabf0 copies the formatted record; writes 0x0101 at destination +0x2b0
fast_today_mode_1.conclusion: A save-backed mail record is copied into the four-slot route collection when the native eligibility/payload checks pass.

fast_tomorrow_mode_2.native_method: 0xac7070 via record virtual slot +0x30; both indexed record pointer-array candidates resolve to this method
fast_tomorrow_mode_2.slot_picker: 0xfad340 checks sixteen slots and returns the first available slot plus its ordinal
fast_tomorrow_mode_2.record_writer: 0xfaa3f0 copies the action's formatted record payload into the selected slot; follow-up code counts valid slots and updates related save state
fast_tomorrow_mode_2.conclusion: The cFastTomorrow route reaches a native save-backed 16-slot record insertion path at action execution, subject to its validity and free-slot checks.

slow_retry_mode_3_fallback.native_method: 0xac7070 via record virtual slot +0x30 after 0xac1ff0 returns false

system_mail_send.eventflow_example: The only indexed HHA mail action is BuildCelebration, with Route=cFastTomorrow; it therefore reaches the mode-2 record path. It is not the HHA grade report producer.
system_mail_send.timing_and_boundary: The action inserts a save-backed route record when its EventFlow method executes. The route names identify Today/Tomorrow paths, but static evidence does not prove the exact clock/date at delivery, eventual mailbox visibility, inbox insertion, or successful arrival. No live runtime capture was available.

route_virtual_slot.exact_constructor_global_crosswalk: unresolved; both candidate arrays agree on the +0x30 target
